The '''Model RPS-8 Rocket Launcher''' was a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]. It was primarily marketed towards system defense forces and mercenaries, but also found its way into the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. While not the most sophisticated rocket launcher in the market, it was still a capable and lethal weapon.<ref name="ROE" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the description for the weapon, it is also referred to as the "RPS-18 rocket launcher."
